messages:
dana: quick proposal  instead of one giant remediation backlog, split postmortem actions into lanes: urgent, standard, and runway. each lane has SLA + ownership pattern
rafael: what's runway?
dana: runway = strategic/non-blocking items with 30-90d horizon. urgent = <7d, standard = 7-30d
anika: how do we prevent ownership drift across lanes? that's our recurring pattern
dana: introduce ownership escrow: IC assigns a temporary owner at handoff; owner must accept or reassign within 24h. if none, squad lead is auto-assigned and inc escalation fires
tom: can we make this enforceable by inc-bot? anika: yes pls
ops-bot: inc-bot: I can create remediation cards with lane tags (urgent/standard/runway), set escrow timer (24h), and ping owners automatically. confirm opt-in for board integration
rafael: escalation flow?
dana: flow: 24h accept window -> 48h owner update required for urgent -> 7d re-escalation to remediation council if no progress. standard gets 72h accept and weekly check-ins, runway gets 5 business day accept and monthly digest
anika: add recurrence fingerprinting: tag PM with "recurrence:hot" if same signal >3 times in 90d, which triggers high-priority lane review
tom: how does IC rotation change?
dana: new rule: outgoing IC must create remediation placeholder cards for all candidate actions and set escrow before handoff. incoming IC verifies or escalates. this reduces dangling tasks when IC swaps
rafael: comms cadence for stakeholders? one-liner on incident channel at handoff and a short ETA update at next check-in (48/72h depending on lane)
anika: tiny pasteable template for lane card and comms:
```
REMEDIATION CARD
- Lane: urgent|standard|runway
- Owner: @owner (escrow: accept within 24h)
- Action: one-line intent
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
- Blockers: short list
- Recurrence: none/possible/hot
- Next check-in: +48h (urgent) / +7d (standard) / monthly (runway)
STAKEHOLDER NOTE: Mitigation committed; owner @owner; ETA: YYYY-MM-DD; impact: reduced error rate / mitigation scope
```
ops-bot: inc-bot suggestion: auto-tag "recurrence:hot" after 3 incidents with matching fingerprint; can open a remediation council ticket automatically
dana: next steps: 1) ops-bot prototype lane tags & escrow (tom) 2) add lane guidance to incident KB (anika) 3) update IC handoff checklist to require placeholder cards (rafael) 4) pilot for 2 weeks then measure closure latency by lane (dana)
tom: on it. prototyping inc-bot escrow + card template, ETA 5 days
rafael: I'll PR the checklist change and run a small training during next IC rotation
anika: adding KB doc now, will include examples and recurrence fingerprinting rules
dana: goal = reduce ownership lag and make recurring patterns visible earlier. small changes, measurable outcome :chart_with_upwards_trend:
